title: Bee Removal in Carle Place, NY
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee nest removal in Carle Place, Long Island. Licensed technicians treat nests in walls, attics, eaves, and ground burrows. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides expert stinging insect removal throughout Carle Place — wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, carpenter bees, and ground-nesting bees. Our licensed technicians understand the unique challenges faced by Carle Place homeowners and businesses, from historic residential areas to commercial districts along Old Country Road. We identify the species, locate the nest, treat it directly, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization.
whyUs: Our team combines years of experience with eco-friendly bee removal techniques specifically tailored to Long Island properties. We offer same-day emergency service to Carle Place residents, transparent pricing with no hidden fees, and a commitment to relocating bees whenever possible rather than extermination.
localContext: Carle Place's mix of well-established single-family homes near the Village of Mineola border and commercial properties along Glen Cove Road creates ideal nesting conditions for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets, especially during spring and summer months. The mature trees throughout neighborhoods like those surrounding Carle Place Middle School and the proximity to retail centers make paper wasp and bald-faced hornet nests common in eaves, soffits, and wall voids. Carpenter bees damage wooden trim, decks, and siding. Ground-nesting yellow jackets establish colonies in yards and landscaping beds, where foot traffic triggers defensive stinging.

faqs.answer: We offer same-day and emergency service throughout Carle Place and surrounding Long Island communities. faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Carle Place?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: What types of stinging insects do you remove in Carle Place?
faqs.answer: We treat wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, carpenter bees, bumblebees, and ground-nesting bees. Carle Place properties frequently experience carpenter bee damage to wooden siding, decks, and trim, as well as wasp and hornet nests in attics, wall voids, eaves, and soffits. Yellow jacket ground nests are common in landscaping beds and along foundation perimeters. Our technicians identify the species, locate the nest, treat it directly, remove accessible nest material, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization.
